prompts.baekje:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production-ready RPG portrait sprite atlas. Draw all characters listed below ON ONE SHEET at once, strict evenly spaced 4 columns x 4 rows grid on a genuinely transparent alpha background. Square sheet. Every cell same size, head centered, all hair/crowns and faces fully within cell with 12% transparent gutters on every edge. Head and face ONLY, tiny neck collar allowed, no shoulders, no bodies, no weapons, no scenery, no frame, no text or labels, no checkerboard painted in. Cute hand-drawn female chibi anime Korean Three Kingdoms tactical game style, bold clean ink lines, polished warm cel shading, expressive oversized eyes, individual face shapes. ALL historical figures reimagined as female characters, including monarchs and enemies, consistent with Samhan Girls project. Ensure each person visibly distinct. Each head occupies about 75% cell height and appears at same scale; no overlapping cells. Transparent space between every head. Read cells left to right then top to bottom. Empty unused final cells must remain fully transparent. Baekje blue and antique gold accents; lotus motifs.
Cell 1, row 1 column 1: 계백 — navy twin braids, violet eyes, gentle smile, gold lotus pin.
Cell 2, row 1 column 2: 윤충 — blue high ponytail, fierce blue eyes, commander brow.
Cell 3, row 1 column 3: 의자왕 — regal dark updo, Baekje gold crown with floral ornaments, elegant confident gaze.
Cell 4, row 1 column 4: 성충 — long ash blue hair, narrow wise eyes, scholar hairpiece.
Cell 5, row 2 column 1: 은상 — short navy wavy bob, broad cheeks, resolute gaze.
Cell 6, row 2 column 2: 의직 — swept blue black hair, scar on eyebrow, fiery grin.
Cell 7, row 2 column 3: 충상 — teal straight hair, archer headband, attentive eyes.
Cell 8, row 2 column 4: 상영 — dark blue low bun, square jaw, stoic eyes.
Cell 9, row 3 column 1: 흥수 — silver blue long hair, calm eyes, simple scholar cap.
Cell 10, row 3 column 2: 흑치상지 — dark skin, ink blue wild ponytail, gold eyes, confident smile.
Cell 11, row 3 column 3: 복신 — short dark indigo hair, angular face, indomitable expression.
Cell 12, row 3 column 4: 도침 — female Buddhist strategist, shaved head, peaceful expression, tiny prayer beads at collar.
Cell 13, row 4 column 1: 부여풍 — blue black long flowing hair, small Baekje gold crown, youthful royal elegance.
